propositions: Existing auto-bug filers (heartbeat-alert, binding-drift-alert, conflict-filer) lack dedup, templating, and empty-detail abort, leading to spam and silent breakage on gate changes.
Heartbeat-alert filer must implement 2-consecutive-red threshold via workflow run-history query to filter single flakes, with dedup tag, templated body, and abort-if-empty.
Binding-drift-alert filer has no red/green cycle signal and drift is persistent state; it receives dedup + accumulation (<=1 per 24h) + abort-if-empty without threshold, rationale documented.
Conflict-filer must use stable per-conflict dedup tag (local-id + jira-key hash), template, abort-if-empty, and detected_by stamp; no auto-close (investigation required).
All three filers must reference the bug-creation contract documenting exact rebar create args, exit codes, dedup search command, and REBAR_DETECTED_BY env var for future filers.
Accumulation dedup and recovery no-op logic (green with no open ticket) must be unit-tested; query failures must fail toward NOT filing with loud logging.
